messages.content: Dukaan pe bhaiya se bolna hai ki "yeh shirt thodi badi hai, chhota size dikhao". English mein kya bolun?
You can say: "This shirt is a little big for me. Could you show me a smaller size, please?" Use "Could you" to sound polite.
Boss ko mail likhna hai ki main kal office nahi aa paunga kyunki ghar mein function hai. Ek line chahiye.
Try this: "Dear Sir, I will not be able to come to the office tomorrow because of a family function. Please grant me a day's leave." It is short, polite and clear.
My son teacher ko bolna chahta hai "Mam, mujhe samajh nahi aaya, please dobara samjhaiye". How he can say in English?
He can say: "Ma'am, I did not understand. Could you please explain it once more?" Asking this way is polite, and teachers like it when students ask.
Hospital ke reception pe bolna hai ki mera Dr. Rao ke saath 11 baje ka appointment hai. English?
At the reception you can say: "Good morning. I have an appointment with Dr. Rao at eleven o'clock." Then give your name if they ask for it.
Bank counter pe passbook update karwana hai. Kaise bolun?
Say: "Hello, I would like to get my passbook updated, please." If the clerk asks for it, hand over the passbook and say, "Here it is."
Station pe kisi se poochna hai ki Pune jaane wali train kaun se platform pe aayegi. English mein?
You can ask: "Excuse me, which platform will the train to Pune arrive at?" Or a shorter way: "Excuse me, where can I find the Pune train?"
Phone pe bolna hai "Main Anil bol raha hoon, kya Mr. Shah se baat ho sakti hai?"
Say: "Hello, this is Anil speaking. May I speak to Mr. Shah, please?" In English we say "this is Anil speaking", not "I am Anil".
Diwali pe apne boss ko wish karna hai. Short aur formal line chahiye.
Try: "Wishing you and your family a happy and bright Diwali, Sir." If you want it a little warmer, add: "May the year ahead bring you good health and happiness."
Cousin ki shaadi hai. Dulhan ko congratulate karna hai English mein, thoda pyara sa.
You can say: "Congratulations on your wedding! You look lovely today, and I wish you and your husband a lifetime of happiness together."
Is sentence ko English mein bata do: "Mujhe kal subah jaldi uthna hai."
In English: "I have to wake up early tomorrow morning." You can also say "I need to get up early tomorrow."
"Woh abhi tak ghar nahi pahuncha" ka English kya hoga?
It is: "He has not reached home yet." We use "has not ... yet" for something that is still not done at the time of speaking.
"Baarish ki wajah se match cancel ho gaya." English me kaise likhein?
Write: "The match was cancelled because of the rain." You can also say "The match was called off due to rain."
Translate this: "Tum itne dino se kahan the?"
In English: "Where have you been all these days?" Or, more simply, "Where have you been for so long?"
Mummy ne kaha "Khana kha ke hi jaana." English sentence kya hoga?
It is: "Eat before you leave." If you want to sound a little stronger, say: "Do not go without eating something first."
I am knowing him since five years. Is this right?
Not quite. Say: "I have known him for five years." Why: "know" does not usually take the -ing form, and "for" is used with a length of time, while "since" is used with a starting point.
Please check my sentence: "She don't likes spicy food."
Correct form: "She doesn't like spicy food." Why: with "she" we use "doesn't", and after "doesn't" the main verb stays in its base form, so "likes" becomes "like".
Yesterday I go to market and buyed vegetables. Sahi hai kya?
Not yet. Say: "Yesterday I went to the market and bought vegetables." Why: "go" and "buy" are irregular verbs, so their past forms are "went" and "bought". Also, "the market" needs an article.
He is more taller than me. Please correct.
The correct sentence is: "He is taller than me." Why: "taller" is already a comparative form, so we do not add "more" before it.
I have a doubt in this chapter, can you explain? Teacher said it is wrong.

A better sentence is: "I have a doubt about this chapter" or, more commonly, "I have a question about this chapter." Why: "doubt" means you are not sure something is true, while "question" is the normal word for something you want explained.
Me and my friend is going to cinema tomorrow.
Correct form: "My friend and I are going to the cinema tomorrow." Why: two people need "are", not "is". It is also polite to put the other person first, and "the" comes before "cinema".
Colleague said "Let's circle back on this." Iska matlab kya hai?
It means "let's talk about this again later." The person wants to leave the topic for now and return to it after more thought or information. It is common in offices and is not rude.
My manager wrote "Kindly do the needful." What does it mean? Is it okay English?

It means "please do whatever is necessary to finish this task." It is common in Indian offices, but people in other countries may find it unclear. A clearer way is: "Please process this request and let me know when it is done."
Teacher ne remark likha "Needs improvement". Bura hai kya?

It is not harsh. It means the work is not yet at the expected level and can get better with more effort. It is a gentle way of saying "try harder and fix the weak parts". Ask your teacher which parts to improve.
Principal said "Parents are requested to remain present." Means compulsory?
Yes, in most schools this means parents are expected to come. "Are requested" sounds polite, but the school really wants everyone there. If you cannot attend, tell the class teacher before the day.
Neighbour ko bolna hai "Raat ko music band karo" lekin politely. Kaise?

Try: "Sorry to trouble you, but could you please keep the music low at night? We are finding it hard to sleep." A casual version for a friendly neighbour is: "Hey, could you turn the music down a bit?"
"Give me water" ko polite kaise bolte hain restaurant mein?
You can say: "Could I have some water, please?" or "May I get a glass of water, please?" Both are polite. "Give me water" sounds like an order.
Friend ko casual mein aur interviewer ko formal mein "I am late" kaise bolun?
Casual, to a friend: "I'm running late, sorry!" Formal, to an interviewer: "I apologise for the delay. I will be there in a few minutes." Use the formal one when you do not know the person well.
Sabzi wale se bolna hai ki "Aadha kilo tamatar do aur thoda dhaniya free mein". English?

Say: "Half a kilo of tomatoes, please. And could you throw in a little coriander too?" "Throw in" means to add something extra for free, and it sounds softer than asking for "free" coriander directly.
Meeting mein apni baat rakhni hai, "Main kuch bolna chahta hoon." Kaise start karun?
You can start with: "May I say something?" or "If I may, I would like to add a point." Both let you step in politely.
Class mein bahar jaane ki permission lene ke liye kya bolte hain?
Say: "Ma'am, may I go out, please?" Some teachers like the full form: "May I please go to the washroom?" Wait for the teacher to say yes before you leave.
Auto wale ko English mein bolna hai "Meter se chalo, extra paisa nahi dunga".
You can say: "Please go by the meter. I will pay only what it shows." Say it calmly and clearly, and do not raise your voice.
Call pe awaaz kat rahi hai. Unhe kaise bolun ki dobara bolo?
Say: "Sorry, your voice is breaking up. Could you please say that again?" Or: "I cannot hear you clearly. Could you repeat that?"
Dadi ki birthday hai. Card pe likhne ke liye ek pyari English line batao.
Write: "Happy Birthday, Dadi! Your stories and your love make our home special. We love you very much." Keep the card short so the handwriting stays neat.
Eid pe dost ko message bhejna hai. English mein kya likhun?
Write: "Eid Mubarak! May this day bring you joy, peace and lots of sweet moments with your loved ones." You can add your friend's name at the start.
Reception pe poochna hai ki report kab milegi. Kaise puchun?
Ask: "Excuse me, when will my report be ready?" If you want to ask about the day, say: "Could you tell me when I can collect my report?"
Bank mein bolna hai ki mera cheque book khatam ho gayi hai, nayi chahiye. English?
Say: "I have used all the leaves in my cheque book. I would like to request a new one, please." The clerk will tell you what form to fill.
I am having a request, can you please give me one day leave?
A better sentence is: "I have a request. Could you please give me a day off?" Why: "have" is not used with -ing when it means "own" or "hold", and "a day off" or "a day's leave" is the usual phrase.
She said me that she will came tomorrow.

Correct form: "She told me that she would come tomorrow." Why: we say "told me" (or "said to me"), not "said me". After "told", "would" is the usual past form of "will", and after it the verb stays in its base form, so "came" becomes "come".
Boss ne bola "I will revert by evening." Revert ka matlab to wapas jaana hota hai na?

In most English, "revert" does mean go back, but in Indian offices "I will revert" means "I will reply to you." Other countries may find that confusing. A clearer line is: "I will get back to you by evening."
"Mujhe bhookh lagi hai, kuch halka khane ko milega?" English mein bolo.
In English: "I am hungry. Can I get something light to eat?" The word "light" here means a small, easy meal.
Teacher ko "Aap meri help karo" polite tarike se kaise bolun?
Say: "Could you please help me with this, ma'am?" or "I would be grateful for your help." Add the word "please" and use "could", and it sounds respectful.
Return karna hai kapde, kya bolun? Size fit nahi hua.
You can say: "I would like to return this. The size does not fit. Could I exchange it for another size, please?" Keep the bill with you.
Wrong number lag gaya. Politely kaise bolun?
Say: "Oh, I am sorry. I think I have dialled the wrong number." Then end the call kindly with: "Have a good day."
Colleague ne bola "Please do the needful and revert." Mujhe kuch samajh nahi aaya, kya karna hai?
She is asking you to do what is needed for the task and then reply to her. First complete the job. Then write back: "The work is done. Please tell me if anything more is needed."
Aur agar mujhe kuch pata hi nahi ki needful kya hai to?
Then ask her directly: "Could you tell me exactly what you need from me?" It is always fine to ask for clear steps when an instruction is vague.
Interview mein "Tell me about yourself" ka jawab kaise shuru karun? Main fresher hoon.
Start like this: "Good morning. My name is Neha, and I have just finished my degree in commerce. I enjoy working with numbers and learning new things." Then mention one skill and one goal.
Weakness puchhe to kya bolun?
Pick a small, real weakness and show how you are improving it. For example: "I sometimes take too long to finish small tasks, so now I make a daily list and set time limits."
Hotel ke reception pe check-in karna hai. Kya bolun?
Say: "Hello, I have a booking under the name Arjun Mehta. I would like to check in, please." Keep your ID ready, as they usually ask for it.
Aur kamra thoda shaant chahiye to?
Ask: "Could I have a quiet room, away from the road, if one is available?" Adding "if one is available" keeps it polite.
Holi pe Australian friend ko invite karna hai. Kaise likhun?
Write: "Hi Sam, we are celebrating Holi, the festival of colours, this Sunday at 10 a.m. at my house. Wear old clothes, as we will play with colours. Please come and join us!"
Usko kaise samjhaun ki Holi kya hai?
Say: "Holi is a spring festival in India. People throw coloured powder and water at each other, share sweets and meet family and friends. It celebrates the arrival of spring."
Please tell what is wrong: "I am agree with you."
Correct form: "I agree with you." Why: "agree" is a verb, so we do not use "am" before it.
Aur "I am not agree" kaise bolun?
Say: "I do not agree." Why: for the negative we use "do not" with the base verb, so "I do not agree" is correct.
Bank wale ne bola "Please fill the form in capital letters." Matlab?
It means write every letter in the form as a big letter, like "RAVI KUMAR", not "Ravi Kumar". Banks ask for this so that the writing is easy to read.
Aur "block letters" kya hota hai?
"Block letters" means the same thing: clear, separate, capital letters. Use a pen and write one letter in each box if the form has boxes.
Sir se kehna hai "Aap please mujhe ek chance do." Formal tarike se?
Say: "Sir, I would be grateful if you could give me one more chance." The words "I would be grateful" make the request very respectful.
Aur dost se casual mein?
Say: "Hey, give me one more chance, okay?" It is relaxed and fine with a friend, but do not use it with a teacher or a boss.
Restaurant mein waiter ko bolna hai ki khana kam teekha banaye. English?
Say: "Could you please make it less spicy?" If you want only a little spice, say: "Medium spicy, please."
Post office mein parcel bhejna hai Delhi. Counter pe kya bolun?
Say: "I would like to send this parcel to Delhi. How much will it cost, and how many days will it take?" Keep the address written on the parcel.
Salon mein bolna hai "Baal thode chhote kar do, bas do inch." English?
Say: "Please trim my hair a little, just two inches." "Trim" means to cut a small amount.
Airport pe check-in counter pe bolna hai ki mujhe window seat chahiye.
Say: "Could I have a window seat, please?" If none is left, they may offer an aisle seat, which is next to the walkway.
Library mein librarian se kehna hai ki yeh kitaab ek hafte aur rakhni hai. English?
Say: "Could I keep this book for one more week, please?" The librarian may say "renew". That means extend the loan time.
College office mein poochna hai ki admission ki last date kya hai. Kaise?
Ask: "Excuse me, what is the last date for admission?" You can add: "Is there a form I should fill in?"
Landlord se bolna hai ki geyser kharab hai, theek karwa do. English me polite line?
Say: "Sir, the geyser is not working. Could you please arrange to get it repaired?" If it is urgent, add: "We are facing some trouble without hot water."
Clinic ke reception pe bolna hai ki mujhe doctor se milna hai, pehli baar aaya hoon.
Say: "Hello, this is my first visit. I would like to see the doctor, please." They will ask for your name and phone number to make a file.
Is line ka English batao: "Chai thandi ho gayi, ise garam kar do."
In English: "The tea has gone cold. Please heat it up." You can also say "Could you warm this tea for me?"
"Mere paas time nahi hai, baad mein baat karte hain" ko English mein kaise kahein?
Say: "I don't have time right now. Let's talk later." A softer way is: "I'm a bit busy now. Can we talk later?"
"Usne mujhe galat samjha" English?
In English: "He misunderstood me." Or: "She got me wrong." Use "misunderstood" when writing and "got me wrong" when chatting.
Translate karo: "Mujhe pata nahi tha ki tum aa rahe ho."
In English: "I did not know that you were coming." We use "were coming" because we are talking about the past.
"Kitni der lagegi?" ko shop mein ya office mein English mein kaise bolein?
Ask: "How long will it take?" It works everywhere: in a shop, at a repair centre or at an office counter.
He have two sisters and one brothers. Please fix it.
Correct form: "He has two sisters and one brother." Why: with "he" we use "has", and "one" is followed by a singular noun, so "brothers" becomes "brother".
I am going to home now. Is this correct?
Correct form: "I am going home now." Why: "home" is used here as an adverb, so we do not put "to" before it.
Can you correct: "I didn't went to school yesterday."
Correct form: "I didn't go to school yesterday." Why: after "didn't" the verb takes its base form, so "went" becomes "go". "Didn't" already shows the past.
She is working here since 2019. Sahi hai?
Not quite. Say: "She has been working here since 2019." Why: when an action began in the past and still continues, we use the present perfect continuous, not "is working".
My sister is elder than me by two years. Correct me.
A natural sentence is: "My sister is two years older than me." Why: "elder" is mostly used for family members and not with "than" in modern English, and the number of years comes before "older".
Please check: "Give me your pen, I will return you tomorrow."
Correct form: "Please give me your pen. I will return it to you tomorrow." Why: the thing you return is "it", and we say "return it to you". Adding "please" also makes the request polite.
I like very much this song. Is it wrong?
Yes, the word order is wrong. Say: "I like this song very much." Why: in English, the object ("this song") comes right after the verb, and "very much" goes after it.
Senior ne mail mein likha "Please find attached." Iska kya matlab hai?
It means "I have attached a file to this email, and it is for you to look at." It is a common way to introduce an attachment in a formal email.
Teacher ne bola "Don't be a bookworm." Kya yeh bura hai?
A bookworm is someone who reads a lot. Here the teacher probably means "do not only read; play and meet people too". It is not a harsh remark, but it can sound teasing.
Office mein sabne kaha "He is on leave till further notice." Kab aayega?
"Till further notice" means no return date has been set yet. The office will tell people when it is decided. So the answer is: nobody knows yet.
Notice board pe likha tha "Admission on first-come, first-served basis". Samajh nahi aaya.
It means the people who apply first get the seats first. When all the seats are taken, the rest cannot join. So it is best to apply early.
Friend said "I will ping you." Ping kya hota hai?
"To ping someone" means to send a short message to get their attention. "I will ping you" means "I will message you soon". It is casual, so use it with friends and coworkers, not in a formal letter.
Customer care wale ko "Mera kaam jaldi karo" politely kaise bolun?
Say: "I would be very thankful if you could look into this soon." A simpler version is: "Could you please help me with this as soon as possible?"
Shop pe "kuch aur dikhao" ke liye formal aur casual dono bolo.
Formal: "Could you please show me some other designs?" Casual: "Got anything else?" Use the first with a stranger and the second with a friendly shopkeeper you know well.
Seat chhodne ke liye kisi se kaise bolun? Bus mein bahut thaka hoon.
Ask: "Excuse me, would you mind if I sat here?" if a seat is free, or: "Sorry, could I please have this seat? I am quite tired." Be ready to accept a "no" kindly.
Raksha Bandhan pe bhai ko message likhna hai. Pyara sa.
Write: "Happy Raksha Bandhan, Bhai! Thank you for always standing by me. I am lucky to have a brother like you."
Ganesh Chaturthi pe padosiyon ko prasad dena hai. Kya bolun?
Say: "Happy Ganesh Chaturthi! Please take some prasad. It is a sweet offering from our puja." If they are from another country, "puja" means a prayer ceremony.
Mere chacha ki death hui hai. Condolence message English mein kaise likhun?
Write: "I am so sorry for your loss. My thoughts are with you and your family. Please accept my deepest sympathies." Keep it short and simple. You can add his name or "my uncle" if you wish.
Bus conductor se poochna hai ki Shivaji Nagar kab aayega. English?
Ask: "Excuse me, could you tell me when we reach Shivaji Nagar?" You can add: "Please let me know when it comes."
Parent-teacher meeting mein teacher se poochna hai ki mera beta kaisa kar raha hai.
Ask: "How is my son doing in class?" A fuller question is: "Could you tell me how he is doing in studies and with his friends?" It shows that you care about both.
Phone pe bolna hai ki "Aap thoda ruko, main abhi aata hoon." Formal English?
Say: "Could you please hold on for a moment? I will be right with you." On a phone call, "hold on" means wait without hanging up.
Dukaan wale se discount maangna hai. Rude na lage.
Say: "Is there any discount on this?" or "If I buy two, could you give me a better price?" Both are polite. Smile, and accept it if the answer is no.
Colleague ko bolna hai "Yeh kaam meri zimmedari nahi hai". Rude na lage.
Say: "I think this task belongs to the accounts team. Shall I tell you who to ask?" It explains clearly and does not blame anyone.
Aur agar boss ne diya ho wahi kaam?
Say: "Sir, I am already handling two tasks. Could we decide which one comes first?" This shows you are willing to help, but it makes the load clear.
Interview ke end mein "Aap kuch puchna chahte hain?" pe kya bolun?
You can ask: "What would a normal day in this role look like?" or "What skills would help me most in the first three months?" Both show interest in the job.
Aur agar kuch nahi poochna ho?
Say: "Thank you, you have answered my questions already. I appreciate your time." That is polite and ends the interview well.
Teacher ko bolna hai ki bukhar ki wajah se kal nahi aaya. Application likhni hai.
Write: "Respected Ma'am, I could not attend school yesterday because I had a fever. Kindly excuse my absence. Yours obediently, Rahul." A parent can sign the note as well.
Isme "obediently" kyun likhte hain?
It is an old-style closing used in some school letters in India, and it shows respect to the teacher. Nowadays "Yours sincerely" or "Thank you" is also fine. Check what your school prefers.
Train ticket cancel karwana hai, counter pe kya bolun?
Say: "I would like to cancel this ticket, please. Here is my PNR number." The PNR number is the booking code printed on the ticket.
Refund kitna milega ye kaise puchun?
Ask: "How much money will I get back after cancelling?" Or: "Could you tell me the refund amount, please?"
Navratri mein garba ke liye dost ko invite karna hai. Kya likhun?
Write: "Hi Lisa, would you like to come to garba with us on Saturday evening? It is a folk dance done during Navratri. You do not need to know the steps. We will teach you!"
Aur uski dress ke baare mein kya bolun?
Say: "Wear something colourful and comfortable. Many women wear a chaniya choli and men wear a kurta, but any bright clothes are fine."
She said me "I am feeling hungry". Is it okay?
Close, but "said me" is not correct. Say: "She told me, 'I am feeling hungry'" or "She said, 'I am hungry.'" Why: "tell" takes a person directly, but "say" does not.
Aur "I am feeling hungry" sahi hai?
It is understood, but most people say "I am hungry." Why: "hungry" is a state, so the simple present is more natural than "am feeling".
Boss ne kaha "Let's take this offline." Kya matlab?
It means "let's talk about it separately, not in front of everyone". It usually happens after a meeting, in person or by phone. It is not a punishment.
Aur "Let's park it" ka?
"Let's park it" means "let's stop talking about this for now and keep it for later". The idea is the same as leaving a car in a parking spot.
Meri bahu ko English mein kaise introduce karun mehmanon se?
Say: "This is my daughter-in-law, Priya." In English, a son's wife is a "daughter-in-law", and a daughter's husband is a "son-in-law". Use the first phrase when you introduce her.
Aur apne jeth ko?
Your husband's older brother is your "brother-in-law". English does not separate older and younger. You can say "my husband's elder brother" if you want to be exact.
Class ke bacchon ko "chup raho" ke bajaye kya bolun? Main tutor hoon.
Try: "Please settle down, everyone." or "Let's keep our voices low so that we can all hear." Children respond better to a calm, friendly request.
Casual version bhi chahiye mere cousin ke liye.
For a cousin you can say: "Hey, shh, keep it down a bit!" It is friendly and relaxed. Do not use it in a class.
Mobile repair shop pe "Screen toot gayi hai, kitna lagega?" English mein.
Say: "My phone screen is cracked. How much will it cost to repair?" You can also ask: "How long will it take?"
Ye bhi bolna hai ki pehle price bata do phir kaam karna.
Say: "Please tell me the price first. I will decide after that." This is clear and polite.
Cricket match mein dost ko bolna hai "Catch chhod diya, koi baat nahi, agli baar pakad lena." English?
Say: "You dropped the catch. Never mind, you will get the next one." "Never mind" here means "it is okay, do not worry".
Society meeting mein bolna hai ki parking ki jagah kam hai. Kaise bolun?
Say: "There is not enough parking space for everyone. Could we find a fair way to share it?" Starting with the problem and then asking for a solution keeps the meeting calm.
Mera English bolne mein jhijhak lagti hai. Office mein kaise improve karun?
Start small. Say two or three sentences at each meeting. Write down new words you hear and use them the next day. Mistakes are normal, and most people are happy to help.
One of my friend are coming to the party. Please correct.
Correct form: "One of my friends is coming to the party." Why: after "one of" the noun is plural ("friends"), but the verb agrees with "one", so we use "is".
"Aaj mausam bahut suhana hai" ka English kya hoga?
In English: "The weather is lovely today." You can also say "It is a beautiful day today."
Canteen wale bhaiya ko order dena hai: do samosa aur ek chai, sugar kam. English?
Say: "Two samosas and one tea, please, with less sugar." Short orders like this are normal at a canteen.
Courier boy ko phone karke bolna hai ki main ghar pe nahi hoon, parcel guard ko de do.
Say: "I am not at home right now. Please leave the parcel with the security guard." Then add: "Thank you."
Gym mein trainer se poochna hai ki yeh machine kaise use karte hain. English?
Ask: "Could you show me how to use this machine, please?" Or: "How do I adjust the weight on this one?"
Shaadi mein kisi ko bolna hai "Aap dulhe ki taraf se hain ya dulhan ki?" English mein.
Ask: "Are you from the groom's side or the bride's side?" It is a friendly way to start a talk at a wedding.
Electrician ko bulana hai kyunki fan nahi chal raha. Phone pe kya bolun?
Say: "Hello, the ceiling fan in my house is not working. Could you come and check it today or tomorrow?" Then give your address and name.
Exam hall mein invigilator se extra sheet maangni hai. English?
Raise your hand and say quietly: "Excuse me, sir, may I have an extra answer sheet, please?" Wait until the invigilator brings it.
Airport pe security wale ne poocha "Anything to declare?" Kya matlab?
It means "do you have anything that you must tell the officers about, such as goods or large amounts of money?" If you have nothing, say: "No, nothing to declare."
Mere senior ne kaha "Let's not reinvent the wheel." Matlab?
It means "let's not build something new when a good solution already exists". The team should use the existing method and save time.
Mail mein "Regards" aur "Warm regards" mein kya farak hai?
Both are polite email endings. "Regards" is neutral and a little formal. "Warm regards" is friendlier and suits people you already know. Use "Yours sincerely" for very formal letters.
Class mein sir ne kaha "Don't beat around the bush." Hum bush ko kyun maarenge?
Nobody is hitting a bush! It is an idiom. It means "do not avoid the main point; say it directly". So the teacher wants a clear answer.
Result pe likha tha "Promoted on trial." Bura hai kya?
It means the student moves to the next class for now, but the school will watch the progress. If the marks improve, the promotion stays. Ask the class teacher what you need to do.
Is sentence ka English chahiye: "Woh ladki jo kal aayi thi, meri behen hai."
In English: "The girl who came yesterday is my sister." "Who" connects the girl to the action of coming.
"Aap ka naam kya hai aur aap kahan se hain?" English mein bolo.
In English: "What is your name, and where are you from?" These two questions are the usual start when you meet someone new.
"Mujhe thodi der ke liye akela chhod do" polite English?
Say: "Could you please give me some time alone?" A more casual version is: "I need a little space right now."
"Jaldi karo, hum late ho rahe hain" ko English mein translate karo.
In English: "Hurry up, we are getting late." Or: "Quick, we are running late."
Hindi mein: "Agar baarish hui to hum picnic cancel kar denge." English mein?
In English: "If it rains, we will cancel the picnic." After "if" we use the simple present ("rains"), not "will rain".
He is good in cricket. Please check preposition.
Correct form: "He is good at cricket." Why: we say "good at" when we talk about a skill, and "good in" is not usual.
I am waiting you since one hour.
Correct form: "I have been waiting for you for one hour." Why: "wait" needs "for" before the person, and "for one hour" is used with a length of time, not "since".
Sir, may I come in? Is it correct if I say "May I come inside?"
Both are fine. "May I come in?" is the usual one. "May I come inside?" is also correct, but "in" is more common in everyday speech.
My mother is cooking since morning. Fix this.
Correct form: "My mother has been cooking since morning." Why: for an action that began in the past and is still going on, we use the present perfect continuous with "since".
Which one is correct: "I have seen him yesterday" or "I saw him yesterday"?
"I saw him yesterday" is correct. Why: when a sentence names a finished time like "yesterday", we use the simple past, not the present perfect.
The informations you gave was very helpful. Correct it.
Correct form: "The information you gave was very helpful." Why: "information" is uncountable and has no plural form, so we do not add "s", and it takes "was".
I will tell you when will I reach.
Correct form: "I will tell you when I reach." Why: in a statement after "when", the word order stays normal, so we say "I reach" and not "will I reach".
She asked me where do I live.
Correct form: "She asked me where I live." Why: in reported questions, the order is subject then verb, and we do not use "do".
Dost ko aur teacher ko "Kal milte hain" alag-alag kaise bolun?
To a friend: "See you tomorrow!" To a teacher: "I will see you tomorrow, ma'am. Thank you." The second one adds respect with the title and "thank you".
Kisi se bolna hai "Aap galat hain" lekin rude na lage. English?
Say: "I see it a little differently." or "I am not sure that is right. Could we check it together?" These disagree without attacking the person.
Teacher ko "Mujhe late hone ke liye sorry" bolna hai. Formal.
Say: "I am sorry for being late, ma'am. It will not happen again." Keep your voice calm and then take your seat quietly.
Casual aur formal: "Kya aap mujhe address bata sakte hain?"
Formal: "Could you please tell me the address?" Casual: "Can you send me the address?" In a message to a friend, "Address?" is also fine.
Meeting ke baad sab ko "Thank you for your time" bolna sahi hai kya? Kuch aur?
Yes, it is right and polite. You can also say: "Thanks, everyone, for the useful discussion." Choose the one that fits how formal your office is.
Resume mein "Hobbies" ke saath kya likhun? English line chahiye.
Write short phrases such as "Reading novels, playing badminton and cooking." Choose things you really do, because the interviewer may ask about them.
Onam pe Kerala wale colleague ko wish karna hai.
Write: "Happy Onam! Wishing you and your family a joyful festival with lovely food and lots of flowers." A short line like this is enough.
Christmas pe school mein bachchon se kya bolun? Simple English.
Say: "Merry Christmas, children! Today we will sing songs, eat cake and share gifts. Let us be kind to each other." Keep the sentences short so that young children understand.
Meri nani 80 saal ki hain. Unhe birthday pe kya bolun English mein?
Say: "Happy 80th birthday, Nani! You are the heart of our family. We wish you good health and many more happy years."
Mera chhota bhai bahut shararati hai. English mein kaise bataun doston ko?
Say: "My little brother is very naughty." Another phrase is: "He is full of mischief." Both sound affectionate, not harsh.
Hospital ki billing counter pe bolna hai ki bill mein ek item galat lag raha hai.
Say: "Excuse me, I think there is a mistake in this bill. Could you please check this item with me?" Stay calm and keep the papers in your hand.
Bank mein bolna hai ki mera ATM card kho gaya hai. English?
Say: "I have lost my ATM card. Please block it, and tell me how to get a new one." Say it as soon as you notice, and ask the bank what steps to follow.
Phone pe interview ke liye time maanga hai. Kaise bolun?
Say: "Thank you for calling. Could we schedule the interview for tomorrow at 10 a.m.?" If the time does not suit them, ask: "What time would be convenient for you?"
Call karne wale ko bolna hai "Main driving kar raha hoon, baad mein call karta hoon."
Say: "I am driving right now. I will call you back later." It is safer to say it quickly and end the call.
Taxi mein driver ko bolna hai ki AC thoda tez karo. English?
Say: "Could you please turn up the AC a little?" If it is too cold, say: "Could you please turn the AC down a little?"
Padosi ko bolna hai ki unka paani hamari chhat pe tapak raha hai.
Say: "Sorry to bother you, but water from your balcony is dripping onto our terrace. Could you please check it?" Starting with "sorry to bother you" keeps the tone friendly.
Medical store pe bolna hai ki mujhe yeh dawai chahiye, doctor ka parcha hai. English?
Say: "I would like these medicines, please. Here is the doctor's prescription." The shop will read the prescription and tell you the price.
Aur poochna hai ki isme kitna time lagega.
Ask: "How long will it take to get these ready?" The pharmacist will tell you how long.
Beta ne teacher ko likha "Sir, please give me leave, I am not well." Sahi hai?
It is understood, but it can sound like an order. A better version is: "Sir, I am not feeling well. May I please have the day off?" Why: "May I" is a polite request.
Aur application ka subject kya likhun?
Write: "Subject: Request for leave." Under it, give the date and the reason in one or two lines.
Bus stand pe poochna hai ki next bus kab hai Jaipur ki.
Ask: "What time is the next bus to Jaipur?" A short form is: "When does the next Jaipur bus leave?"
Ticket kahan se milega yeh kaise puchun?
Ask: "Where can I buy a ticket?" or "Which counter sells tickets for this bus?"
Appraisal meeting mein "Main aur zimmedari lena chahta hoon" kaise bolun?
Say: "I would like to take on more responsibility. Could we talk about how I can grow in this role?" This shows that you want to learn and grow.
Salary badhane ki baat kaise karun?
Say: "I would like to discuss my pay. Could we talk about it?" Then give your reasons, such as the work you have done. Do not demand; ask to discuss.
Boss ne email mein likha "Please advise." Kya karna hai?
It means "please tell me what you think I should do". The boss wants your suggestion or decision. Reply with a clear opinion, for example: "I suggest we go with option two."
Aur "FYI" ka kya matlab?
"FYI" means "for your information". It says the message is only to inform you, and you do not need to do anything.
Mere dost ne likha "No worries." Gussa hai kya?
No, "No worries" means "it is fine" or "do not worry about it". It is a friendly reply to "sorry" or "thank you".
Aur "Never mind" ka?
"Never mind" can mean "forget it" or "it is not important". It can sound a little cold if said sharply, but it is usually fine in a friendly tone.
Flight ke attendant se "Mujhe ek blanket chahiye" bolna hai.
Say: "Excuse me, could I have a blanket, please?" If you are cold, you can add: "I am feeling a little cold."
Aur khana veg chahiye ye kaise bolun?
Say: "Could I have the vegetarian meal, please?" If you booked it earlier, say: "I ordered a vegetarian meal."
Dussehra ke mela mein foreigner ko Ravan dahan samjhana hai. Simple English.
Say: "On Dussehra, people burn big models of the demon king Ravan. It shows that good wins over evil, as in the story of Lord Ram."
Aur mela mein kya milta hai, ye kaise batayen?
Say: "There are food stalls, rides, small shops and games. People eat sweets and snacks and enjoy the lights." Short sentences make it easy for a visitor to follow.
Please correct: "He told to me that he will helps."

Correct form: "He told me that he would help." Why: "told" is followed directly by the person, with no "to". After "would" the main verb is in the base form, so "helps" becomes "help"; "would" is the usual past form of "will" after "told".
Aur "He said to me" sahi hai?
Yes, "He said to me" is correct. We use "said to" with a person, and "told" without "to". The meaning is the same.
Dost ne party pe bulaya hai lekin main nahi ja sakta. Politely mana kaise karun?
Say: "Thanks for inviting me, but I will not be able to come. I hope you have a great time!" You do not have to give a long reason.
Maine auto wale se kaha "Keep the change". Kya yeh sahi English hai?
Yes, it is correct. "Keep the change" means "you may keep the extra money, I do not need it back". It is polite when you pay a little more than the fare.
Dost ko birthday pe surprise dena hai. "Tumhare liye ek surprise hai" English mein?
Say: "I have a surprise for you!" If you want to keep it secret, say: "Wait and see. You will love it."
Football coach ne bola "Mark your man." Kya matlab hai?
It means "stay close to the player you are guarding so that he cannot get the ball easily". Each defender watches one opponent.
Class teacher ko poochna hai "Homework kab tak jama karna hai?" English?
Ask: "Ma'am, by when should we submit the homework?" A shorter question is: "What is the last date for the homework?"
Mujhe projects mein group leader banna hai. Teacher ko kaise request karun?
Say: "Ma'am, I would like to lead our group in this project. I will make sure everyone does their part." Showing a plan helps the teacher trust you.
Library mein dost ko chup karana hai, politely.
Whisper: "Sorry, could we talk a little more quietly? People are studying here." Or: "Shh, let's talk outside."
Office mein kisi ka kaam mujhe karna padta hai. Kaise bolun ki aaj nahi ho payega?
Say: "I would like to help, but I cannot finish it today. Can I do it first thing tomorrow?" Giving a new time shows you are still willing.
Boss ko bolna hai ki deadline thodi badhao. English line chahiye.
Say: "Sir, I need a little more time to finish this properly. Could we extend the deadline by two days?" A clear request with a reason usually works best.
HR ne bola "Please submit your documents at the earliest." Earliest matlab sabse pehle?
Almost. "At the earliest" means "as soon as possible". It does not give a fixed date, but they want the documents quickly. It is safe to submit them in a day or two.
Railway enquiry pe bolna hai ki train kitni late hai batao.
Ask: "Could you please tell me how late the train is running?" You can also ask: "What is the expected arrival time?"
Foreign mein dost ko bolna hai "Main kal wapas aaunga". Yeh to simple hai na?
Yes. Say: "I will be back tomorrow." You can also say "I will return tomorrow", which is a little more formal.
Visiting hours ke baare mein poochna hai nurse se. English?
Ask: "Excuse me, what are the visiting hours?" You can also ask: "Can I stay with the patient for a while?"
Bank mein loan ke baare mein jaankari chahiye. Receptionist se kaise puchun?
Say: "Hello, I would like some information about loans. Who should I speak to?" The receptionist will guide you to the right desk.
Pongal pe wish karna hai. Short English line?
Write: "Happy Pongal! May your home be filled with joy and good food." You can add your friend's name at the start.
Lohri ke din ghar pe aag ke paas dost ko kya bolun?
Say: "Happy Lohri! Let's enjoy the bonfire, the songs and the sweet treats together." Short and cheerful is best.
Mummy ke liye Mother's Day card pe kuch likhna hai.
Write: "Dear Mummy, thank you for your love and for always taking care of us. Happy Mother's Day!" It is short, so the card stays neat.
Bhaiya ki naukri lagi hai. Congratulate kaise karun?
Say: "Congratulations on your new job, Bhaiya! I am so proud of you. All the best for your first day." Say it with a smile!
Is sentence ko English mein likho: "Humein kal tak intezaar karna padega."
In English: "We will have to wait until tomorrow." "Have to" shows that there is no other choice.
"Mujhe neend aa rahi hai" ka English?
In English: "I am feeling sleepy." Or simply: "I am sleepy."
"Tum mere saath chalo" ko do tareeke se English mein bolo: order aur request.
Order: "Come with me." Request: "Would you please come with me?" The second one is better with strangers or elders.
Hindi se English: "Is raste se seedhe jaoge to bank aa jayega."
In English: "If you go straight along this road, you will reach the bank." This is a useful way to give directions.
"Woh bachpan se hi bahut shant hai." Translate please.
In English: "He has been very quiet since childhood." "Since" shows the starting point, and "has been" shows that he is still quiet.
Teacher said me to submit the homework tomorrow. Please check.
Correct form: "The teacher told me to submit the homework tomorrow." Why: "told" takes the person directly, but "said" does not, and "the teacher" needs an article.
This is the book who I bought yesterday.
Correct form: "This is the book that I bought yesterday." Why: "who" is for people, while "that" or "which" is for things.
My brother have a new bike but he never wear helmet.
Correct form: "My brother has a new bike, but he never wears a helmet." Why: with "he" the verbs take -s ("has", "wears"), and "helmet" needs an article. Safety note: a helmet is important.
I am very much interested on music. Correct it.
Correct form: "I am very much interested in music." Why: we say "interested in", not "interested on".
Can you tell me the way to the nearest bank please
Your sentence is understood. With correct writing it is: "Can you tell me the way to the nearest bank, please?" Why: add a comma before "please" and a question mark at the end.
He suggested me to go by train.
Correct form: "He suggested that I go by train" or "He advised me to go by train." Why: "suggest" is not followed by a person and "to", but "advise" is.
I will meet you on next Monday. Right?
Correct form: "I will meet you next Monday." Why: we do not use "on" before "next" when we talk about a coming day.
Everyone have done their work? Please correct.
Correct form: "Has everyone done their work?" Why: "everyone" takes a singular verb, so we use "has", and in a question the helping verb comes first.
I stay in Mumbai from last year.
Correct form: "I have been staying in Mumbai since last year." Why: "since" goes with a starting point, not "from", and the present perfect continuous shows that you still stay there.
Shopkeeper ne galat change diya. Kaise bataun?
Say: "Excuse me, I think you gave me the wrong change. Could you check again, please?" "I think" makes it sound gentle, not like an accusation.
Seniors ko "Aapne mera kaam nahi kiya" bolna hai bina bura lage.
Say: "I was waiting for that task. Could you tell me when it will be done?" It focuses on the work, not on blaming the person.
Casual: "Bhai, chalo". Formal: "Aap chalein." English dono.
Casual: "Come on, let's go!" Formal: "Shall we go?" or "After you, please." You can use the casual one with close friends.
Jewellery shop pe bolna hai ki mujhe light weight chain dikhaiye.
Say: "Could you show me a lightweight chain, please?" You can add: "Something simple and not too heavy."
Fruit wale se "Yeh mitha hai na?" puchna hai. English?
Ask: "Is this sweet?" or "Are these mangoes sweet?" Many sellers will let you taste a piece if you ask.
Dhaba pe "Bill laiye" kaise bolte hain?
Say: "Could we have the bill, please?" You can also say "Check, please," but "bill" is more common in India and Britain.
Phone pe bolna hai "Kripya apna naam aur number bataiye." English mein?
Say: "Could you please tell me your name and number?" You may add: "Could you spell your name for me?"
Dost ko bolna hai "Mera ghar paas mein hai, aao chai pee lo". English?
Say: "My house is nearby. Come over for a cup of tea." "Come over" means visit someone's home.
Interviewer ko "Mujhe is job ki zaroorat hai" kaise bolun bina begging ke?
Say: "I am very interested in this role, and I believe my skills fit it well." This sounds confident and does not beg.
Aur "Mujhe kaam ka experience nahi" ke baare mein?
Say: "I do not have work experience yet, but I learn quickly. In college I did an internship and led a small project." Use only true facts about yourself.
Maine teacher se bola "Ma'am, I forget my homework at home." Kya sahi hai?
Not quite. Say: "Ma'am, I forgot my homework at home." Why: the event is finished, so we use the past tense "forgot", not "forget".
Aur kal le aunga yeh kaise bolun?
Say: "I will bring it tomorrow." This tells the teacher you are responsible.
Dawat mein host ne poocha "Aur lenge?" Mujhe mana karna hai. English mein?
Say: "No, thank you. It was delicious, but I am full." If you want to refuse politely, "I am full" is enough.
Aur agar thoda aur chahiye to?
Say: "Yes, please. Just a little more." If you really loved it, add: "This is very tasty."
Boss ka call miss ho gaya. Kya message likhun?
Write: "Sorry, Sir, I missed your call. I will call you back right away." If the boss is waiting, call at once.
Aur meeting mein tha to ye kaise bataun?
Write: "I was in a meeting and could not take your call. May I call you in half an hour?"
Class mein "Hands up" aur "Hands down" ka kya matlab?
"Hands up" means raise your hand, for example to answer a question. "Hands down" means lower your hand. In another sense, "hands down" can also mean "easily", as in "She won hands down".
Aur "Show of hands" ka?
"A show of hands" is a way of voting. The teacher asks everyone to raise a hand for the choice they like, and then counts the hands.
Meeting mein "Any other business" likha hai. Kya yeh sawal hai?
It is a section of the meeting, not a question. After the main topics, people can bring up any other points. It is usually the last item on the agenda.
Wahan mujhe kuch bolna ho to?
Say: "I have one more point." Then say your point in two or three sentences.
She is married with a doctor. Is it okay?
Not quite. Say: "She is married to a doctor." Why: we say "married to" a person, not "married with".
Aur "He is married since five years"?
Say: "He has been married for five years." Why: "for" goes with a length of time, and the present perfect shows that he is still married.
Hamari family mein sab bahut baat karte hain. English mein kaise bolun "Humari family bahut bada hai"?
Say: "My family is very big." Or: "I come from a big family." Why: in English we say a family is "big", and "a big family" needs the article "a".
Aur joint family ko kaise samjhaun?
Say: "A joint family is when parents, children, grandparents and sometimes uncles and aunts all live together in one house."
Mujhe kisi ko bolna hai "Mujhe aapki madad chahiye." Alag-alag tareeke?
Formal: "I would be grateful for your help." Polite: "Could you please help me?" Casual: "Can you give me a hand?" Pick the one that suits the person.
"Give me a hand" ka literal matlab to haath dena hota hai na?
Yes, but here "give me a hand" is an idiom. It means "help me". Nobody needs to hand over a real hand.
Dost ko bolna hai "Dekho, aasman mein indradhanush nikla hai!" English mein.
Say: "Look, there is a rainbow in the sky!" You can also say: "A rainbow has appeared!"
Library se kitaab lauta raha hoon, late fee ke baare mein kaise poochun?
Ask: "I am returning this book a few days late. Is there a late fee?" The librarian will tell you the rule.
Tailor ko bolna hai ki blouse ki sleeves thodi chhoti kar do. English mein kaise bolun?
You can say: "Could you please make the sleeves of this blouse a little shorter?" Starting with "Could you please" keeps it polite.
Dhobi ko bolna hai ki shirt pe daag hai, pehle usko saaf karna. English?
Say: "There is a stain on this shirt. Please clean that first." The word "stain" means a mark that is hard to remove.
Doodhwale bhaiya ko bolna hai ki kal se aadha litre extra doodh chahiye.
You can say: "From tomorrow, I need half a litre more milk, please." It is short and clear.
Gas agency ko phone pe bolna hai ki cylinder khatam ho gaya hai, naya bhej do.
Try this: "My gas cylinder is empty. Please send a new one." The word "empty" means there is nothing left inside.
"Humne gaon mein mela dekha" - ye English mein kya hoga?
It is: "We saw a fair in the village." In English, a "fair" is a place where people meet for games, food and shopping, like a village festival with rides and stalls.
Correct me: "She is knowing the answer."
The correct sentence is: "She knows the answer."
My cousin says "Do one thing, you go home first." My foreign colleague got confused. What is the problem?
"Do one thing" is a common way in India to start a suggestion, but others may wonder what the "one thing" is. Say: "I suggest you go home first." That is clear to everyone.
Bheed mein se nikalna hai. Kisi ajnabi ko aur dost ko "raasta dena" alag-alag kaise bolun?
To a stranger: "Excuse me, may I get past, please?" To a friend: "Hey, make some room, let me through." The first is polite, the second is casual.
Online form mein "Date of birth" ke saath "DD/MM/YYYY" likha hai. Iska matlab?
It means you write the day first, then the month, then the year, all as numbers. For example, the fifth of March 2001 is written 05/03/2001.
Form mein "Permanent address" aur "Correspondence address" hai. Dono mein kya farak hai?
Your permanent address is your long-term home address. Your correspondence address is where you want to receive letters now, for example your hostel. They can be the same.
Hospital reception pe poochna hai ki lab kahan hai, mujhe blood test ke liye jaana hai.
You can say: "Excuse me, where is the lab? I have to go for a blood test."
Aur poochna hai ki kitna wait karna padega.
Ask: "How long do I have to wait?" It works at any counter.
Savings account kholne ka form kahan milega? Bank counter pe kaise poochun?
Say: "Excuse me, where can I get the form to open a savings account?" It is polite and gets straight to the point.
Padosi ko bolna hai ki aapka kachra hamare darwaze ke saamne pada hai, please hata dein.
Say: "I asked our neighbour to remove the garbage in front of our door, but it is still there. Could you please help?" Keep your voice calm and polite.
Agar wo phir bhi na hataye toh society office ko kya bolun?
Say: "There is garbage in front of our door. Could you please ask the neighbour to remove it?" Keep your voice calm and polite.
Koi mujhe "Eid Mubarak" bole toh main kya jawab dun?
You can reply: "Eid Mubarak to you too." Or say: "Thank you, and the same to you." Both are warm and natural.
Karwa Chauth pe vrat hai. Office mein kaise bataun ki main aaj lunch nahi karungi?
Say: "I am fasting today for Karva Chauth, so I will not have lunch." The word "fasting" means not eating for a religious reason.
School bus ke driver ko bolna hai ki mera beta kal bus se nahi aayega.
You can say: "My son will not take the bus tomorrow." If you add his name, the driver will know which child you mean.
Tuition teacher ko bolna hai ki yeh chemistry ka chapter dobara padhaiye.
Say: "Sir, could you please teach this chemistry chapter again?" Use "Ma'am" if your teacher is a woman.
Phone pe kisi ko bolna hai "Aapka number meri list mein nahi hai." English?
You can say: "Your number is not in my contact list." The "contact list" is the saved numbers on your phone.
Dost ko voice message bhejna hai: "Main raaste mein hoon, 10 minute mein pahunch raha hoon." English mein?
Say: "I am on my way. I will be there in 10 minutes." The words "on my way" mean you have already left.
Train ticket booking mein "Berth preference" likha hai. Matlab?
A berth is a sleeping bed in a train. "Berth preference" asks which kind of berth you would like, for example a lower one or an upper one.
"Kal raat bahut shor tha, isliye main so nahi paya." Translate karo.
It is: "There was a lot of noise last night, so I could not sleep." Use "could not" for something you were not able to do.
Please check: "I have went to the temple yesterday."
The correct sentence is: "I went to the temple yesterday."
Is this right? "The news are very shocking."
The correct sentence is: "The news is very shocking."
Fix my sentence: "I want to know that where is the post office."
The correct sentence is: "I want to know where the post office is."
Ek Indian ne mujhse poocha "What is your good name?" Kya ye sahi English hai?
People say it in India, but standard English just says "What is your name?" The word "good" is not needed. A more polite form is: "May I know your name?"
My office people say "He is out of station." My foreign client did not understand.
"Out of station" is common in India, but other English speakers may not know it. Say: "He is out of town." That is clear everywhere.
Teacher ne bola "Don't mug up." Mug up ka matlab kya hai?
To "mug up" means to learn something by heart without understanding it. It is informal. The teacher wants you to understand the lesson, not just repeat it.
Commentator bola "He is on a roll." Iska matlab kya hai?
It means a person is doing very well, one success after another. For example: "She won three matches in a row; she is on a roll."
Aur kya ye bure results ke liye bhi bolte hain?
No, it is usually positive. For repeated bad results, people say "a losing streak".
Waiter ko aur dost ko "aur chai dena" alag tareeke se kaise bolun?
To a waiter: "Could I please have some more tea?" To a friend: "Give me some more tea." The first is polite, the second is casual.
Bachche ko bolna hai "Haath dho ke aao, phir khaana khao." English mein?
Say: "Go and wash your hands, then come and eat."
Aur agar wo na sune toh "Maine kaha na!" kaise bolun?
You can say: "I already told you!" Say it calmly, so the child hears the words and not only the tone.
Bank wale ne bola "Please take a token." Token kya hota hai?
A token is a small slip or card with a number on it. Take it from the machine and wait until your number is called.
Aur agar mera number nikal gaya aur main wahan nahi tha?
Go to the counter and say: "Excuse me, I missed my number. What should I do?" The staff will tell you the next step.
Client ko bolna hai ki unki file kal subah tak bhej dunga. English?
You can say: "I will send your file by tomorrow morning." The word "by" means not later than that time.
Bahut din baad purana colleague mila. "Kaafi time ho gaya, kaise ho?" kya bolun?
Say: "It has been a long time. How are you?" It sounds friendly and natural.
Petrol pump pe bolna hai "Full tank kar do." English mein?
You can say: "Fill the tank, please." Or just: "Full tank, please." Both are fine.
Aur "Bas yahan utaar do" cab driver ko?
Say: "Please drop me here." It is polite and short.
Airport pe "Mera bag nahi aaya" kaise bataun?
Tell the airline staff at the airport: "My bag has not arrived." Then show them your baggage tag if you have one.
Meri behen ka beta mera bhanja hai. English mein kya bolte hain?
He is your nephew. You can say: "My sister's son is my nephew."
Aur bhanji?
She is your niece. "My sister's daughter is my niece."
Sasur aur saali ko English mein kya bolte hain?
Sasur is "father-in-law". Saali, your wife's sister, is "sister-in-law".
Padosi ko chaabi dekar jaana hai: "Main teen din bahar hoon, plants ko paani de dijiye."
You can say: "I will be away for three days. Please water my plants." Add "Thank you so much" when you hand over the key.
Rangoli ko English mein kaise samjhaun?
Say: "A rangoli is a pattern made on the floor with coloured powder, rice flour or flowers. People make it for festivals like Diwali."
Notebook pe "Name, Class, Roll No." likha hai. Roll No. matlab kya hai?
"Roll No." means roll number. It is the number your school gives you in the class list.
Roll number aur admission number same hote hain kya?
Not always. The roll number is your place in the class list. The admission number is given when you join the school, so they are often different.
Password banate waqt "at least 8 characters" likha hai. Matlab?
It means your password must have eight or more characters, such as letters, numbers or symbols. "At least" means not fewer than that.
Please correct: "Please send me the photo's of the function."
The correct sentence is: "Please send me the photos of the function."
He do not came yesterday. Fix it please.
The correct sentence is: "He did not come yesterday."
This is the most easiest question in the paper. Is it fine?
No. Say: "This is the easiest question in the paper." "Easiest" already means "most easy", so "most" is not needed.
"Mujhe tumse ek baat poochni hai" - English?
You can say: "I want to ask you something." Or: "I have a question for you."
"Wo kal se bimaar hai" ka English kya hoga?
It is: "He has been ill since yesterday." Use "has been" with "since" for something that started in the past and is still true.
Dost ko bolna hai "Tune toh kamaal kar diya!" Casual English mein?
Say: "You did a great job!" Or even more casual: "That was amazing!"
Ghar mein mehmaan aaye hain. "Aap kuch lenge?" English mein kaise poochun?
Say: "Would you like something?" It is polite for guests.
Aur chhote bachche ko?
For a child, you can say: "Do you want something?" It is simpler and friendlier.
Phone pe number bolna hai. English mein "88" ko kaise bolte hain?
When the same digit comes twice in a row, you can say "double eight". Or say "eight, eight". Both are fine.
Aur "0" ko?
Say "zero". Some people say "oh", which is common when speaking a phone number.
Number lamba ho toh kaise bolun?
Say it in small groups and pause after each group, so the listener can write it down.
"Mujhe sochne ke liye thoda time chahiye" - kaise bolun English mein?
You can say: "I need some time to think." It is polite and works in almost any situation.
Cinema hall mein ticket window pe kaise bolun: do ticket, beech ki row mein?
You can say: "Two tickets in the middle row, please."
Aur kisi se poochna hai ki ye seat khaali hai ya nahi.
Ask: "Excuse me, is this seat free?" It is polite and short.
Film khatam hone ke baad dost se poochna hai ki use kaisi lagi. English?
You can ask: "How did you like the movie?" Another way is: "What did you think of the movie?"
Shaadi mein gift dete waqt kya bolun? Mujhe kehna hai "Ye aapke liye hai, mere aashirwad ke saath."
Say: "This is for you, with my blessings." "Blessings" means good wishes given with love.
Parlour mein bolna hai ki dono haath pe simple mehendi lagana. English mein?
You can say: "Please apply a simple henna design on both my hands." Henna is a plant-based colour used to draw designs on the hands.
Mujhe padosi ke kutte se darr lagta hai. Unse kehna hai "Kripya apne kutte ko baandh kar rakhiye."
Say: "Please keep your dog tied up." Saying "please" keeps it friendly, even if you feel nervous.
Mali bhaiya ko bolna hai "Gulaab ke paudhe ko roz paani do." English?
Try this: "Please water the rose plant every day." Here "water" is a verb and means to give water to a plant.
Aur "zyada paani mat dena" kaise bolun?
Say: "Please do not give it too much water."
Mandir mein jootey kahan utaarun? Kisi se English mein kaise poochun?
Ask: "Excuse me, where can I leave my shoes?" People will understand you easily.
Picnic ke group mein poochna hai "Kaun kya laayega?" English mein?
You can write: "Who is bringing what?" It is short and natural for a group chat.
Result aane wala hai aur dost ghabra raha hai. "Sab acha hoga" English mein kaise bolun?
Say: "Everything will be fine." You can add: "Do not worry." It sounds kind and calm.
Race mein chhoti behen ko cheer karna hai. Kya chillaun English mein?
You can shout: "Come on! You can do it!" These are short words that are easy to shout.
Annual day pe stage se bolna hai "Aap sabka swagat hai." English?
Say: "Welcome, everyone." You can also say: "We are happy to have you all here." Both are fine for a stage.
Science fair mein judge ko dikhana hai ki mera model paani ko saaf karta hai. Kaise bolun?
Say: "This model cleans water." Use the simple present tense to say what a thing does.
Roommate se kehna hai ki mera charger mat uthana. Politely kaise bolun?
You can say: "Please do not take my charger." Or softer: "Could you please not take my charger?"
Mess mein roti kam padh gayi. Server se aur roti kaise maangun?
Say: "Could I have some more rotis, please?" The word "more" is what shows you want extra.
Society secretary ko likhna hai ki paani ka tanker kal nahi aaya.
You can write: "The water tanker did not come yesterday." Use "did not come" because it is about a finished day.
Bijli ke bill pe "Due date" likha hai. Iska matlab kya hai?
The due date is the last day by which the bill should be paid. It is written on the bill so that you know the deadline.
Bus pass ke form mein "Valid till" likha hai. Iska matlab?
"Valid till" gives the last date when the pass can be used. After that date, it does not work.
Photo studio mein bolna hai "Passport size photo chahiye, white background mein."
Say: "I need a passport-size photo with a white background."
Mera chashma tut gaya hai, frame badalna hai. Optician ko kaise bolun?
Say: "My glasses are broken. I need a new frame." The word "glasses" is always plural in this meaning.
Mochi ko bolna hai ki chappal ka strap tut gaya hai, sil do.
You can say: "The strap of my sandal is broken. Could you stitch it, please?"
Carpenter bhaiya ko bolna hai ki darwaza band nahi hota, ek baar dekh lo.
Say: "The door does not close. Could you have a look at it?" "Have a look" is a friendly way to ask someone to check something.
"Maine aaj subah jaldi uthkar yoga kiya." Translate karo.
It is: "I got up early this morning and did yoga." Use "did yoga", not "done yoga", because the action is finished.
Aur "Maine kal yoga nahi kiya"?
It is: "I did not do yoga yesterday." After "did not", the verb stays in its base form, "do".
"Tumhe kya lagta hai, kal baarish hogi?" English mein?
It is: "Do you think it will rain tomorrow?" Use "will" for a guess about the future.
"Agar tum aate toh maza aata." English?
It is: "If you had come, it would have been fun." This form talks about something that did not happen.
Aur "Agar main tumhari jagah hota toh main na jaata"?
It is: "If I were in your place, I would not go." Use "were" after "if" when you imagine something unreal.
"Mujhe laga ki tum ghar pe ho." Translate please.
It is: "I thought you were at home." Use "were" because the sentence is in the past.
Check my English: "She is very taller than me."
The correct sentence is: "She is much taller than me."
Please explain me this chapter. Is it right?
No. Say: "Please explain this chapter to me." The verb "explain" needs "to" before the person.
We discussed about the plan yesterday. Any mistake?
Yes. Say: "We discussed the plan yesterday." The verb "discuss" takes its object directly, so "about" is not needed.
Is this right? "I have visited Jaipur last year."
The correct sentence is: "I visited Jaipur last year."
Toh "I have visited Jaipur" kab sahi hota hai?
It is correct when you do not say when, for example: "I have visited Jaipur twice." The present perfect is used when the time is not named.
Each of the students have a book. Correct it please.
The correct sentence is: "Each of the students has a book."
Fix this: "I look forward to meet you."
The correct sentence is: "I look forward to meeting you."
My friend wrote "She is afraid from dogs." What is wrong?
The correct sentence is: "She is afraid of dogs."
Please correct: "Their going to the market."
The correct sentence is: "They're going to the market."
My friend says "I am just doing timepass." My foreign colleague did not understand. What should I say?
"Timepass" is common in India, but many English speakers do not know it. Say: "I am just passing the time." Or: "I am just killing time."
My relatives say "cousin brother". Is that correct English?
"Cousin" already covers boys and girls, so "cousin brother" sounds odd to others. In standard English, just say "my cousin".
In office I say "I will tell you in the evening only." Does it sound wrong?
People in India say "only" for emphasis, but others may read it as a strange limit. Say: "I will tell you in the evening." It is clear and natural.
In bus, people say "Kindly adjust." Foreigners look confused. What can I say?
"Kindly adjust" is common in India, but it is not clear to everyone. Say: "Could you please move over a little?" That is polite and clear.
Receipt pe likha hai "Goods once sold will not be taken back." Matlab kya hai?
It means the shop will not take back an item after you buy it. So check the item before you pay.
Metro platform pe "Mind the gap" likha tha. Matlab?
It means "Be careful of the gap between the train and the platform." Look at your step when you get in or out.
Letter mein "Yours faithfully" aur "Yours sincerely" mein kya farak hai?
Use "Yours faithfully" when you begin with "Dear Sir or Madam" and do not know the name. Use "Yours sincerely" when you begin with a name, like "Dear Mr Rao".
Drama se pehle dost ne bola "Break a leg!" Mujhe bura laga. Kya wo gussa tha?
No, it is a kind wish. "Break a leg" means "good luck", and people say it to actors before a show.
Kya main ise cricket player ko bol sakta hoon?
Not really. "Break a leg" is mainly for stage and performances. For sports, say: "Good luck!"
Phone pe "Kaun bol raha hai?" ko formal aur casual dono tareeke se English mein batao.
Formal: "May I know who is calling, please?" Casual: "Who's this?" The first one is better for offices and strangers.
Manager ko aur colleague ko alag-alag bolna hai "Maaf karna, traffic mein phans gaya tha."
To your manager: "I am sorry I am late. I was stuck in traffic." To a colleague: "Sorry, I got stuck in traffic."
Teacher ne kaha "See me after class." Kya main mushkil mein hoon?
Not necessarily. It only means the teacher wants to talk to you after the lesson. It could be about anything.
Jab milun toh kya bolun?
Say: "Excuse me, you asked me to see you after class. How can I help?"
Cricket academy ke coach se baat karni hai. "Mere bete ko cricket seekhna hai" English mein?
You can say: "My son wants to learn cricket."
Aur poochna hai ki batch ka time kya hai.
Ask: "What is the batch timing?" You can also say: "What time is the batch?"
Phone pe kisi ka naam suna nahi. Kaise kahun "Naam ki spelling bataiye"?
Say: "Could you spell your name, please?"
Aur spelling bolte waqt "M for Mango" bolna theek hai?
Yes. You can say "M for Mango" or "M as in Mango". Many people also use names, like "M for Mike".
Agar unhone galat suna toh kya bolun?
Say: "Sorry, I meant M, not N." Then say the letter again slowly.
Bank ke guard se poochna hai ki manager sahab kahan milenge.
Ask: "Excuse me, where can I find the manager?"
Manager ne poocha "What is it regarding?" Iska matlab?
It means "What is it about?" Tell him the reason for your visit, for example: "It is about my account."
Office mein photocopy wale se bolna hai ki is page ki do copy chahiye.
Say: "I need two copies of this page." Or: "Could you make two copies of this page, please?"
Colleague ka birthday hai. Sabke saamne bolna hai "Happy birthday, treat kab de rahe ho?" Casual English?
You can say: "Happy birthday! When are you giving the treat?" It sounds friendly with colleagues.
Porter ko bolna hai ki ye do bag platform number 3 tak le chalo.
Say: "Please take these two bags to platform number 3." Show the bags with your hand so he knows which ones.
Chai tapri pe "kadak chai, kam cheeni" kaise bolun English mein?
You can say: "Strong tea with less sugar, please."
Aur "ek chai bina cheeni ke"?
Say: "One tea without sugar, please." "Without" means not including something.
Ice-cream wale se bolna hai "do scoop vanilla aur ek chocolate". English?
Say: "Two scoops of vanilla and one of chocolate, please." A "scoop" is one round portion of ice cream.
Golgappe wale bhaiya ko "meetha pani kam, teekha zyada" kaise bolun?
Say: "Please give me less sweet water and more spicy water." It is a clear request that he will understand.
Bill mein "service charge" laga hai. Waiter se poochna hai ye kya hai.
Ask: "What is this service charge on the bill?" A service charge is an extra amount that the restaurant adds for its service.
Waiter ne bola "It is included in the bill." Matlab?
It means the amount is already part of the total you see on the bill.
Bacha hua khana ghar le jaana hai. Waiter ko English mein kaise bolun?
Say: "Could you please pack the leftover food? I want to take it home." Leftover food is food that you did not finish.
Aate ki dukaan pe poochna hai: "Ye atta fresh hai? Kab ka pissa hua hai?"
Ask: "Is this flour fresh? When was it ground?" "Ground" is the past form of "grind", which means to crush into powder.
Dukaan pe likha hai "Fixed price, no bargaining." Matlab kya hai?
It means the price on the item is final. The shopkeeper will not reduce it, so you do not need to bargain.
Dry cleaner ko bolna hai ki ye kapde kal tak chahiye.
Say: "I need these clothes by tomorrow." If you are asking for a favour, add: "Is that possible?"
Packers ko bolna hai ki glass ka saaman dhyan se rakhna.
Say: "Please handle the glass items carefully." The word "handle" means to hold and move something.
Wifi wale technician ko bolna hai ki internet bahut slow hai.
Say: "The internet is very slow. Could you check it, please?"
Mobile shop pe bolna hai ki phone ki battery jaldi khatam ho jaati hai.
You can say: "My phone's battery runs out quickly." The phrase "runs out" means finishes.
Order pe "Out for delivery" likha aa gaya. Iska matlab kya hai?
It means the delivery person has taken your parcel and is on the way to your address. It should reach you soon.
Form mein kuch jagah "*" aur "Mandatory" likha hai. Matlab?
"Mandatory" means you must fill it. The star mark shows which fields are required, and the form will not go ahead without them.
Account banate waqt "Confirm password" kyun poochta hai?
It asks you to type the same password again. This checks that you did not make a typing mistake the first time.
Email mein "Cc" aur "Bcc" kya hote hain?
"Cc" sends a copy of the mail to another person, and everyone can see that name. "Bcc" also sends a copy, but the other people cannot see the name.
Aur "Reply all" kab dabate hain?
"Reply all" sends your reply to everyone on the mail. Use it only when all of them need to read your answer.
Mail mein bolna hai "Maaf kijiye, attachment lagana bhool gaya tha." English?
Write: "Sorry, I forgot to add the attachment." You can then add: "Here it is."
Mail ke jawab mein "Thanks for your reply" ke bajaye kuch aur likhna hai.
You can write: "Thank you for getting back to me." Or: "Thank you for your quick response."
Subah sabko "Good morning" ke alawa kya bol sakte hain office mein?
You can say: "Hello, everyone." Or: "Hi, how are you today?" Both are friendly and common.
School gate pe guard ko bolna hai ki main bachche ko lene aaya hoon.
Say: "I have come to pick up my child." Add the class if the guard asks which child.
Teacher se kehna hai ki mere bete ko aage ki seat dijiye, use board dikhta nahi.
You can say: "Could you please move my son to a front seat? He cannot see the board."
Professor ko bolna hai ki mujhe aapka lecture bahut accha laga.
Say: "I liked your lecture very much." Or: "I really enjoyed your lecture."
Meri attendance kam hai, kya karun? Ye English mein office staff se kaise poochun?
You can ask: "My attendance is low. What can I do?" Say it politely and wait for them to explain.
Metro card recharge counter pe kya bolun?
Say: "Please recharge this card." Then tell the staff the amount.
Rickshaw wale ko bolna hai "bhaiya, thoda dheere chalo". English mein?
Say: "Please go a little slower." You can also say: "Please slow down."
TTE ko ticket dikhana hai. Kya bolun?
Say: "Here is my ticket." Hand it over when you say it.
Mere dada ji ko wheelchair chahiye. Hospital reception pe kaise poochun?
Ask: "My grandfather needs a wheelchair. Could you help us, please?"
Bank mein account statement maangna hai. Kya bolun?
Say: "I need my account statement, please." If they ask for a period, tell them the dates.
"Tum kab se intezaar kar rahe ho?" - English mein kya hoga?
It is: "How long have you been waiting?" Use "have been waiting" for something that started in the past and still goes on.
"Main tumhe kal phone karunga." Translate karo.
It is: "I will call you tomorrow." Both "call" and "phone" are correct, but "call" is more common.
"Hum log pichhle hafte nani ke ghar gaye the." English?
It is: "We went to our grandmother's house last week." Use the simple past because the time, "last week", is finished.
"Pehle bacchon ko khaana khila do, phir hum khaayenge." Translate please.
It is: "Feed the children first, then we will eat."
"Bahut dino baad aaj dhoop nikli hai." English mein?
It is: "The sun came out today after many days." Another way is: "It is sunny today after many days."
Check this: "My mother-in-law is staying with we."
The correct sentence is: "My mother-in-law is staying with us."
He is an university student. Right?
The correct sentence is: "He is a university student."
Correct please: "She sings very good."
The correct sentence is: "She sings very well."
Please fix: "If it will rain, we will stay home."
The correct sentence is: "If it rains, we will stay home."
Aur agar "when" ho toh?
The same rule works with "when": "When I reach home, I will call you." The part after "when" stays in the present tense.
Is this correct? "She has two childrens."
The correct sentence is: "She has two children."
My teacher marked this wrong: "He suggested to go home."
The correct sentence is: "He suggested going home."
Please correct: "Nobody didn't listen to the teacher."
The correct sentence is: "Nobody listened to the teacher."
Fix it: "We went to the airport for to receive our uncle."
The correct sentence is: "We went to the airport to receive our uncle."
I like to listening music. Is that okay?
The correct sentence is: "I like listening to music."
Colleague said "last-to-last week". My foreign friend did not get it.
"Last-to-last week" is Indian English for "the week before last week". Say: "the week before last". Everyone will understand that.
My colleague says "Don't eat my head." What will a foreigner think?
A foreigner will probably not understand it. In India it means "do not annoy me". A polite way is: "Could we talk about this later? I need to focus now."
I introduce myself as "Myself Ravi." My teacher said change it.
The standard form is: "I am Ravi." Or: "My name is Ravi." The word "myself" is not used as the subject of a sentence.
Aur phone pe kaise introduce karun?
Say: "Hello, this is Ravi." It is clear and polite on a call.
Dost ko aur senior ko alag-alag bolna hai "Chalo, nikalte hain." Kaise?
To a friend: "Let's go." To a senior: "Shall we leave?" The second sounds more respectful.
Manager ko aur dost ko "Mujhe ghar jaana hai" alag-alag kaise bolun?
To a manager: "May I go home now, please?" To a friend: "I have to go home." The first asks permission politely.
Bete ke liye Class 5 mein admission chahiye. School office mein kaise bolun?
Say: "I want admission for my son in Class 5."
Aur fees ke baare mein poochna hai.
Ask: "Could you tell me about the fees, please?"
Cab driver ko phone pe bolna hai ki main 5 minute mein neeche aata hoon.
Say: "I will come down in 5 minutes."
Driver ne poocha "Where are you?" Main building ke gate pe hoon.
Say: "I am at the building gate."
Online class mein sir ko poochna hai ki meri awaaz aa rahi hai ya nahi.
Ask: "Sir, can you hear me?"
Aur camera on karun ya nahi, ye kaise poochun?
Ask: "Should I turn on my camera?"
Chat mein likhna hai ki sir, last point dobara bataiye.
Write: "Sir, could you repeat the last point, please?"
Diwali pe padosi ne mithai di. Unko thank you kaise bolun?
Say: "Thank you so much for the sweets."
Aur unhe Happy Diwali bolna hai poore parivar ke saath.
Say: "Happy Diwali to you and your family."
Appointment ki date badalni hai. Clinic reception pe kaise bolun?
Say: "I would like to change the date of my appointment, please."
Reception pe poochna hai ki mera number kab aayega.
Ask: "When will my turn come?" You can also say: "How long before my turn?"
Reception wale ne bola "Please wait for your turn." Matlab?
It means "Please wait until it is your turn." Take a seat and the staff will call you.
Form bharne mein madad chahiye. Bank staff ko kaise bolun?
Say: "Could you help me fill in this form, please?"
PTM mein teacher se kehna hai ki mera beta ghar pe padhai nahi karta.
Say: "My son does not study at home." Then you can ask: "How can we help him?"
Sir ko bolna hai ki board pe jo likha tha wo mujhse padha nahi gaya.
You can say: "Sir, I could not read what you wrote on the board."
Class mein poochna hai ki kisi ke paas extra pen hai kya.
Ask: "Does anyone have an extra pen?"
Dost ko bolna hai ki kal ka plan cancel ho gaya, sorry.
Write: "Our plan for tomorrow is cancelled. Sorry!"
Aur kal ki jagah parso kar sakte hain?
Ask: "Can we do it the day after tomorrow instead?"
Dost ko message likhna hai "Mujhe tumhari bahut yaad aayi."
Write: "I missed you a lot." The word "missed" here means you felt sad that the person was not there.
"Tum mere liye bahut matlab rakhte ho" - English mein?
It is: "You mean a lot to me." It is warm and honest.
Dadi se poochna hai "Aapne khaana khaya?" Simple English?
Say: "Have you had your meal, Grandma?" Or just: "Have you eaten?"
Bhabhi ko naye baby ki badhai deni hai. English mein kya likhun?
Write: "Congratulations on the new baby!" You can add: "Wishing you all the best."
Chhote bachche ko English mein sikhana hai "Papa, mujhe ye khilona chahiye." Kaise?
Teach him: "Dad, I want this toy." A politer way is: "Dad, could I have this toy, please?"
Kaamwali ko bolna hai ki kal thoda jaldi aa jana.
Say: "Please come a little early tomorrow."
Electrician ne poocha "Where is the main switch?" Mujhe bolna hai ki main switch bahar deewar pe hai.
Say: "The main switch is outside, on the wall."
"Kal se thand badh jaayegi" English mein kya hoga?
It is: "It will get colder from tomorrow."
Aur "garmi badhegi"?
It is: "It will get hotter." Use "hotter" for more heat and "colder" for more cold.
Subah bahut kohra tha, kuch dikh nahi raha tha. English?
It is: "There was a lot of fog this morning. I could not see anything."
"Mor naach raha hai" ko English mein kaise bolenge?
It is: "The peacock is dancing." A "peacock" is the male bird, and the female is a "peahen".
Time English mein bolna hai: "saade paanch", "sawa teen", "paune chaar". Kaise?
Say: "half past five", "quarter past three" and "quarter to four". "Half" and "quarter" give the parts of an hour.
Aur "dhai baje"?
Say: "half past two". It is also correct to say: "two thirty".
Mera birthday 22 March ko hai. English mein kaise bolun?
Say: "My birthday is on the twenty-second of March." In writing you can put: "22 March".
Aur "meri shaadi 5 December ko hui thi"?
It is: "My wedding was on the fifth of December." Use "was" because the day is in the past.
Cash nahi hai. Dukaandar se poochna hai ki card chalega kya.
Ask: "I do not have cash. Do you take cards?"
Interview mein bolna hai ki mujhe aapki company mein kaam karna pasand aayega.
Say: "I would like to work at your company." It sounds polite and direct.
Boss se poochna hai ki meri leave application manzoor hui ya nahi.
Ask: "Sir, has my leave application been approved?" Use "Ma'am" if your boss is a woman.
Meeting aage badhwani hai. Colleague ko kaise bolun?
Say: "Could we postpone the meeting?" If you mean moving it earlier, say "move it earlier" instead.
Aaj mujhe thoda jaldi nikalna hai. Colleague ko English mein?
Say: "I have to leave a little early today."
"Jab tak tum nahi aaoge, main nahi jaaunga." Translate.
It is: "I will not go until you come." After "until", use the present tense, "come", even for the future.
"Usne mujhe bataya ki wo kal nahi aayega." English?
It is: "He told me that he would not come tomorrow." In reported speech, "will" often changes to "would".
"Kaash main usse pehle mil leta" - English mein?
It is: "I wish I had met him before." After "I wish", use "had" plus the past participle for something that did not happen.
"Chaabi kahin gum ho gayi hai." Kaise bolun?
